message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile.
• If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn.
**Note:** Wild Draw Four can only be played if you have no other playable card (unless you’re bluffing; the next player can challenge). | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First to reach the agreed‑upon point total wins the game. | | **Special Rules (Optional)** | • **Stacking** – some groups allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards.
• **Uno Call** – when you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before your turn ends. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards.
• **House Rules** – e.g., “No Wild Draw Four” or “Play a card on a Wild.” | --- ### Quick Play‑through Example 1. **Deal**: Each player gets 7 cards. 2. **Start**: Flip top card – say it’s a red 5. 3. **Player 1**: Has a red 9 → plays it. 4. **Player 2**: Has a blue 9 → plays it. 5. **Player 3**: Has a Draw Two → plays it. Player 4 draws two cards and skips. 6. **Player 1**: Plays a Wild → chooses green. 7. **Player 2**: Plays a green 2. 8. … and so on until someone discards their last card. That’s it! Enjoy a fast, colorful, and slightly chaotic card game that’s great for all ages.
